t.t: Duty schedule | Elite Vet Karlovy Vary
Duty schedule of the Elite Vet veterinary clinic in Karlovy Vary — a monthly calendar with morning and afternoon shifts and the weekend shifts of our doctors.

div.h1: Who is on duty on which day
div.p:
Based on the schedule you can choose a specific doctor or specialisation. Please write your choice in the note when booking your appointment.
If you are not sure which doctor or specialisation to choose, call us or send us an email.

t.t-value: request.env['elite.vet.shift'].sudo().search([ ('date', '>=', ev_first.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')), ('date', '<', ev_next.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) ], order='date asc').sorted(key=lambda r: ( r.date, 1 if r.type_id.is_note else 0, r.type_id.time_from, r.type_id.sequence, r.id )) if ev_has else []

div.p: Swipe sideways to browse the calendar

div.t-attf-class: rs-cell#{' rs-cell--we' if ev_we else ''}#{'' if ev_in else ' rs-cell--empty'}

span.t-attf-class: rs-num#{' rs-num--today' if ev_d == datetime.date.today() else ''}

div.p: Choose the reason for your visit and a free appointment. You will receive a confirmation by email.

span.t-out: (ev_web.booking_loading_title if ev_web else False) or 'Načítáme rezervační systém…'
